output.summary: An evergreen shrub or small tree native from southern Texas to central Mexico, anacahuita bears white funnel-shaped flowers throughout the year and yellow-green, olive-like fruits. The fresh fruits are sweet but slightly toxic and can cause dizziness; jellies made from them are reportedly safe to eat.
output.edibilityNote: Fresh fruits are slightly toxic and may cause dizziness, but fruit jellies are reportedly safe to eat.
